faq_intro: Imibuzo Evame Ukubuzwa mayelana nokuhlanzwa kwamanzi ezimboni, ukukhiqiza kwe-OEM, izitifiketi ze-NSF/ISO, kanye nokunikezwa kwe-wholesale emhlabeni jikelele kusuka ku-Express Water — umkhiqizi ohamba phambili wezihlungi zamanzi ozinze e-China kusukela ngo-1998.

faqs.q: Ingabe izihlungi ze-Express Water ziqinisekisiwe yi-NSF, CE, ISO kanye ne-SGS?
faqs.a: Yebo. Wonke ama-cartridges ethu we-PP melt-blown, CTO carbon block, GAC, UF membrane, T33 post-carbon kanye ne-RO membrane ahloliwe kumazinga we-NSF/ANSI 42, NSF/ANSI 53 kanye ne-NSF/ANSI 58. Isikhungo sethu sinezitifiketi zekhwalithi ye-ISO 9001:2015, uphawu lwe-CE lokuthumela e-Europe, izimemezelo zezinto ezisezingeni le-FDA, isitifiketi se-China 3C sabasabalalisi, kanye nemibiko ephelele yokuhlolwa kwe-SGS heavy-metal & VOC. Isitifiketi se-Halal (JAKIM Malaysia) siyatholakala kuma-oda we-wholesale emakethe yamaSulumane.

faqs.q: Iyini inani elincane le-oda (MOQ) lama-cartridges ezihlungi zamanzi we-OEM/ODM?
faqs.a: I-MOQ yama-cartridges ajwayelekile we-10" PP, CTO kanye ne-GAC iqala ku-1,000 pcs nge-SKU ngayinye yezinto ezikhona, 3,000 pcs yemikhono ephrintwe nge-OEM, kanye ne-5,000 pcs yemikhiqizo ye-ODM eyenziwe ngezifiso ngokuphelele (i-private end-cap, i-custom O-ring, i-branded shrink-wrap). Ama-UF membrane kanye ne-RO 75/100/400 GPD membranes ngokujwayelekile i-MOQ yi-500 pcs. Abasabalalisi abafakwe odongeni i-MOQ ngamayunithi ayi-100. Ama-oda amancane okuzama angaxoxiswana ngawo kwabasabalalisi abasha.

faqs.q: Ikuphi ifektri yenu futhi ingabe abathengi bangavakashela?
faqs.a: Isikhungo sethu sokukhiqiza sise-Yuanhua Town, Haining City, Zhejiang Province, e-China — cishe imizuzu eyi-90 ngemoto kusuka e-Shanghai Hongqiao Airport (SHA) kanye nase-Hangzhou Xiaoshan Airport (HGH). Isikhungo esingaphezu kuka-20,000 m² sinezindawo zokukhipha i-PP melt-blown ezizinikele, imishini yokucindezela i-carbon block, amagumbi ahlanzekile okuhlanganisa i-UF/RO membrane, kanye nemigqa yokuhlanganisa ye-SMT/dispenser. Samukela ukuvakashela kwabathengi okuhleliwe, ukuhlolwa kwabantu besithathu (SGS, BV, TÜV) kanye nokuhlolwa kweziqu ze-OEM.

faqs.q: Yisiphi isikhathi sokuhola (Lead time) okufanele ngisilindele kuma-oda amaningi?
faqs.a: I-PP, CTO, GAC kanye ne-T33 cartridges ejwayelekile enemibala ekhona ithunyelwa zingakapheli izinsuku eziyi-7–10. Ama-cartridges e-OEM private-label anokuphrinta okwenziwe ngezifiso: izinsuku eziyi-20–25 kusukela ekugunyazweni kwemidwebo. Izinto ze-RO/UF membrane: izinsuku eziyi-15–20. Abasabalalisi abafakwe odongeni nabasesitayeleni sedeskithophu: izinsuku eziyi-30–45 kuye ngokwezifiso. Ukulayishwa kwesitsha ngokujwayelekile yi-1 × 20'GP (≈ 80,000 cartridges) noma i-1 × 40'HQ (≈ 200 dispensers). Imigomo ye-FOB Shanghai noma i-Ningbo; CIF, CFR kanye ne-DDP iyatholakala.

faqs.q: Ingabe niphakela ama-RO membranes akho kokubili ukusetshenziswa kwezindlu kanye nezentengiselwano?
faqs.a: Yebo. Sinikezela ngama-reverse osmosis membranes agcwele: 50 GPD, 75 GPD, 100 GPD, 200 GPD, 400 GPD, 600 GPD wezinhlelo zezindlu ezingaphansi kukasinki, kanye ne-300 GPD, 400 GPD kanye ne-600 GPD high-rejection elements yabasabalalisi bamanzi bezentengiselwano abancane. Izinto zezimboni ze-4040 ne-8040 (BW30, SW30 equivalents) ziyatholakala ezitshalweni zokuhlanza amanzi, i-dialysis, i-semiconductor rinse kanye nezicelo zezemithi. Izinga lokulahlwa kukasawoti ≥ 96–99%.

faqs.q: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwe-PP melt-blown, CTO carbon block kanye nezihlungi ze-GAC granular activated carbon?
faqs.a: Izihlungi ze-PP melt-blown sediment zisebenzisa ama-polypopylene fibers aboshwe ngokushisa ukuze kukhishwe ukungcola kwezinhlayiyana (ukugqwala, isihlabathi, udaka) kusuka ku-0.5 kuye ku-50 microns. Izihlungi ze-CTO (Chlorine, Taste & Odor) sintered carbon block zisebenzisa i-coconut-shell ecindezelwe noma i-coal-based activated carbon ukuze kukhishwe i-chlorine yamahhala, ama-chloramines, ama-VOCs, imithi yokubulala izinambuzane kanye nokwenza ngcono ukunambitheka — ngokujwayelekile i-5 µm noma i-10 µm. Izihlungi ze-GAC granular activated carbon zisebenzisa ama-carbon granules axekethile okumuncwa kwe-chlorine isikhathi eside sokuxhumana futhi ngokuvamile ziyisigaba sesibili ezinhlelweni ze-RO zezigaba ezi-5. Sikhiqiza zontathu ngezinga lezimboni ngokulandeleka okugcwele.

faqs.q: Ingabe ningakhiqiza imikhiqizo yokuhlunga amanzi eqinisekisiwe nge-halal yezimakethe zamaSulumane?
faqs.a: Yebo. Singabahlinzeki bezihlungi zamanzi ze-halal abaqashelwa ngokusemthethweni nesitifiketi se-JAKIM Malaysia. Yonke imidiya yokuhlunga (i-activated carbon, amabhola amaminerali, i-KDF, i-ion-exchange resin) kanye nezinto ezithintana nokudla zihambisana ne-halal. Sithumela njalo e-Malaysia, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Egypt, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Turkey, Morocco nakwezinye izimakethe zamaSulumane amaningi nemibhalo ye-halal ifakiwe.

faqs.q: Ingabe ninikezela ngokwenziwa ngezifiso kwe-OEM/ODM kwabasabalalisi bamanzi nabahlanzi?
faqs.a: Impela — i-OEM/ODM iwubuchwepheshe bethu obuyisisekelo. Senza ngezifiso: umbala we-shell ongaphandle (i-Pantone matching), i-logo ye-front-panel silk-screen noma i-laser engraving, ulimi lwe-LED display kanye ne-UI, i-voltage (110V/220V/240V), uhlobo lwe-plug (US/UK/EU/AU), ukupakishwa (ibhokisi lesipho, ikhathoni elinsundu, umkhono wombala), ukuhunyushwa kwebhukwana lomsebenzisi, kanye nezinsiza ezihlanganisiwe. Izindleko zokwenza amathuluzi emijovo emisha ngokujwayelekile ziyabuyiselwa emiqulwini ye-oda ≥ 5,000 units.

faqs.q: Yimiphi imigomo yokukhokha kanye nemigomo yokuhweba eniyamukelayo?
faqs.a: Imigomo ejwayelekile: i-30% T/T deposit ekuqinisekisweni kwe-oda, i-70% balance ngokumelene nekhophi ye-B/L ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa. Samukela futhi i-L/C at sight kusuka emabhange aphambili, i-Western Union kanye ne-PayPal yama-oda we-sample ≤ USD 3,000, kanye ne-Alibaba Trade Assurance kwabathengi bokuqala. Imigomo yokuhweba: i-EXW Haining, i-FOB Shanghai/Ningbo, i-CIF, i-CFR, i-DDP kanye ne-DDU iyatholakala kuye ngetheku lendawo oya kuyo kanye nokuthandwa kwe-incoterm.

faqs.q: Yini isikhathi esijwayelekile sokuphila sama-cartridges akho okuhlunga?
faqs.a: Isikhathi sokuphila somsebenzi esilindelekile sincike kwikhwalithi yamanzi angenayo kanye nokugeleza kwansuku zonke: isihlungi se-PP melt-blown sediment — izinyanga ezi-3 kuye kwezi-6; i-CTO carbon block — izinyanga ezi-6 kuye kwezi-12; i-GAC granular carbon — izinyanga ezi-6 kuye kwezi-12; i-T33 post-carbon — izinyanga ezi-12; i-UF ultra-filtration membrane — izinyanga ezi-24 kuye kwezi-36; i-RO membrane element — izinyanga ezi-24 kuye kwezi-36; i-mineralization / alkaline T33 — izinyanga ezi-12; i-cation-resin softening cartridge — izinyanga ezi-6 kuye kwezi-12 kuye ngobulukhuni bamanzi. Isikhumbuzi sokushintshwa kwe-LED sakhelwe kuwo wonke amamodeli wethu we-smart dispenser.

Siphakela amazwe angaphezu kwama-50 emazwenikazi ayisithupha, nezimakethe ezinkulu ku: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Russia, Ukraine, Poland, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, Iran, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Philippines, South Korea, Japan, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Morocco, Algeria. Ukusebenzisana kwabasabalalisi bendawo kanye nezivumelwano zendawo ezikhethekile zamukelekile.

faqs.q: Ingabe ninikezela ngokusekelwa kwezobuchwepheshe kohlelo lwe-reverse osmosis kanye nensizakalo yangemva kokuthengisa?
faqs.a: Yebo. Wonke umlingani we-OEM uthola: imidwebo yezobuchwepheshe ephelele (PDF/DWG), amabhukwana okuhlangana, amavidiyo wokufaka, amabhukwana womsebenzisi ngezilimi eziningi (izilimi ezingu-45+ ziyatholakala), uhlu lwezingxenye ezisele ezinamakhodi we-PN, ukusekelwa kobunjiniyela be-WhatsApp/email okuzinikele, kanye ne-warranty ekhawulelwe yezinyanga ezi-12 kuye kwezi-24 kuma-housings, membranes kanye nezingxenye ze-elekthronikhi. Ukuthunyelwa konjiniyela endaweni kuyatholakala ekugcotshweni kwezitshalo ze-RO zezimboni ezinkulu ngezindleko ezengeziwe.

faqs.q: Ingabe ama-filter housings enu angaphatha izicelo zezimboni ezinomfutho ophezulu?
faqs.a: Yebo. Sikhiqiza ama-SUS 304 kanye ne-SUS 316L food-grade stainless steel filter housings akalwe afinyelele ku-16 bar (232 psi) working pressure, anezinketho ze-1", 1.5", 2" kanye ne-3" NPT/BSP inlet/outlet. Ama-Big Blue 20" kanye ne-30" housings ku-reinforced PP enemicu ye-brass-insert aphatha afinyelele ku-8.6 bar (125 psi). Yonke imikhumbi yomfutho ihlolwa ngokwe-hydrostatically ku-1.5× rated pressure ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa futhi iza nesimemezelo se-CE PED 2014/68/EU lapho kufanele khona.

faqs.q: Yiziphi izinto ezingavuthiwe kanye nemidiya yokuhlunga eniyitholayo?
faqs.a: Sisebenzisa kuphela izinto ze-food-grade neziyizohlulwa yi-NSF: i-virgin polypropylene resin (ayikho i-PP egaywe kabusha) ye-melt-blown nama-housings; i-coconut-shell activated carbon (≥ 1100 mg/g iodine value) ne-bituminous coal carbon ye-CTO/GAC; i-PVC ne-PES hollow-fiber yama-UF membranes; i-thin-film composite (TFC) polyamide yama-RO membranes; i-food-grade silicone yama-O-rings; i-SS 316L yezinto zokufaka ezihlanzekile; i-FDA-approved ABS ne-PP yama-housings; amaphaneli we-LG Display abasabalalisi abahlakaniphile; izinto zokushisa zethusi eziqinisekisiwe (lapho kufanele khona).

faqs.q: Ngisicela kanjani isicaphuno (quotation), amasampula noma ikhathalogi yomkhiqizo?
faqs.a: Xhumana nathi nge-WhatsApp ku-+86-19908311885 (usekelo lokuthengisa lwamahora angama-24/7, i-English/Chinese/Arabic iyatholakala), i-email expresswater025@gmail.com, noma ugcwalise ifomu lokubuza ekhasini lethu loxhumana naye. Sicela ufake: umkhiqizo ohlosiwe (model/specification), inani, izwe oya kulo, imfuneko yokupakisha, nanoma yiziphi izidingo zokwenza uphawu ngokwezifiso. Ikhathalogi ye-PDF enemininingwane, izitifiketi zomkhiqizo ezigcwele, i-video tour yefektri kanye nohlu lwamanani kuzothunyelwa zingakapheli amahora angama-24 ngezinsuku zomsebenzi.
